@@@FILE README.md
# Salah Time (Android)

Native Kotlin + Jetpack Compose app. **Stage 1** (this repo): splash, onboarding + language, Bengali/English,
dark/light theme, offline prayer times + next-prayer countdown, Hijri/Gregorian date, GPS or city selection,
Qibla compass, Tasbih counter. Settings persist (DataStore).

Not built yet (next stages): Firebase login, Quran, Hadith, Dua, Adhan notifications, FCM, admin panel.

## Build the APK with GitHub (phone only)
1. Create a new GitHub repo and upload ALL files from this folder (keep the `.github/workflows` folder).
2. Open **Actions → Android Build → Run workflow** (it also runs on every push to `main`).
3. When it finishes, open the run and download the **SalahTime-debug-apk** artifact (zip containing the APK).

The workflow installs Gradle 8.7 itself, so no Gradle wrapper file is needed.

## Optional signed release
Add repo secrets: `KEYSTORE_BASE64` (base64 of your .jks), `KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `KEY_ALIAS`, `KEY_PASSWORD`.
The release APK is then built and uploaded as **SalahTime-release-apk**. Never commit a keystore.

## Notes
- Package: `com.bjdfarhma.salah` (matches your Firebase `google-services.json`; added in stage 2).
- Prayer times are astronomical calculations (Karachi default, Hanafi Asr) and may differ a few minutes from local mosque timetables.
- Qibla uses magnetic north from the phone sensor; calibrate in a figure-8.
- Not yet verified by a real build: run the workflow and send me any error log.

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        enableEdgeToEdge()
        val prefs = Prefs(applicationContext)
        setContent { SalahApp(prefs) }
    }
}

@Composable
fun SalahApp(prefs: Prefs) {
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val settings by prefs.flow.collectAsState(initial = null)
    var splash by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { delay(1400); splash = false }
    val st = settings
    SalahTheme(st?.dark ?: true) {
        Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
            when {
                st == null || splash -> SplashScreen()
                !st.onboarded -> OnboardingScreen(st, prefs, scope)
                else -> MainScreen(st, prefs, scope)
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun SplashScreen() {
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize().background(Color(0xFF04130D)), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
        Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
            Image(painterResource(R.drawable.salah_logo), contentDescription = "Salah Time", modifier = Modifier.size(220.dp))
            Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
            CircularProgressIndicator(color = Gold, strokeWidth = 3.dp, modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun OnboardingScreen(s: AppSettings, prefs: Prefs, scope: CoroutineScope) {
    val l = s.lang
    Column(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize().statusBarsPadding().navigationBarsPadding().padding(24.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
    ) {
        Image(painterResource(R.drawable.salah_logo), contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(170.dp))
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        Text(tr(l, "সালাহ টাইমে স্বাগতম", "Welcome to Salah Time"), fontSize = 26.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, textAlign = TextAlign.Center)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        Text(
            tr(l, "নামাজের সময়, কিবলা ও তাসবিহ — ইন্টারনেট ছাড়াই।", "Prayer times, Qibla and Tasbih — even offline."),
            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant, textAlign = TextAlign.Center
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(28.dp))
        Text(tr(l, "ভাষা বাছাই করুন", "Choose your language"), fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
        listOf("bn" to "বাংলা", "en" to "English").forEach { (code, label) ->
            val sel = l == code
            OutlinedCard(
                onClick = { scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.lang] = code } } },
                border = BorderStroke(if (sel) 2.dp else 1.dp, if (sel) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline),
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 4.dp)
            ) { Text(label, Modifier.padding(16.dp), fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = if (sel) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal) }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(24.dp))
        Button(
            onClick = { scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.onboarded] = true } } },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(52.dp), shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
        ) { Text(tr(l, "শুরু করুন", "Get Started"), fontSize = 17.sp) }
    }
}

@Composable
fun MainScreen(s: AppSettings, prefs: Prefs, scope: CoroutineScope) {
    var tab by rememberSaveable { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val items = listOf(
        Triple(Icons.Default.Home, "হোম", "Home"), Triple(Icons.Default.Place, "কিবলা", "Qibla"),
        Triple(Icons.Default.Star, "তাসবিহ", "Tasbih"), Triple(Icons.Default.Settings, "সেটিংস", "Settings")
    )
    Scaffold(bottomBar = {
        NavigationBar {
            items.forEachIndexed { i, it ->
                NavigationBarItem(selected = tab == i, onClick = { tab = i }, icon = { Icon(it.first, null) }, label = { Text(tr(s.lang, it.second, it.third)) })
            }
        }
    }) { pad ->
        Box(Modifier.padding(pad)) {
            when (tab) {
                0 -> HomeScreen(s, prefs, scope)
                1 -> QiblaScreen(s)
                2 -> TasbihScreen(s, prefs, scope)
                else -> SettingsScreen(s, prefs, scope)
            }
        }
    }
}
@@@FILE app/src/main/java/com/bjdfarhma/salah/PrayerCalc.kt
package com.bjdfarhma.salah

import kotlin.math.*

enum class Prayer(val bn: String, val en: String) {
    FAJR("ফজর", "Fajr"),
    SUNRISE("সূর্যোদয়", "Sunrise"),
    DHUHR("যোহর", "Dhuhr"),
    ASR("আসর", "Asr"),
    MAGHRIB("মাগরিব", "Maghrib"),
    ISHA("ইশা", "Isha")
}

/** Offline astronomical prayer-time calculation (no network needed). */
object PrayerCalc {
    data class Method(val id: String, val label: String, val fajr: Double, val isha: Double, val ishaMin: Double = 0.0)

    val methods = listOf(
        Method("KARACHI", "Univ. of Islamic Sciences, Karachi", 18.0, 18.0),
        Method("MWL", "Muslim World League", 18.0, 17.0),
        Method("ISNA", "ISNA (North America)", 15.0, 15.0),
        Method("EGYPT", "Egyptian General Authority", 19.5, 17.5),
        Method("MAKKAH", "Umm al-Qura, Makkah", 18.5, 0.0, 90.0)
    )

    private fun rad(d: Double) = Math.toRadians(d)
    private fun deg(r: Double) = Math.toDegrees(r)
    private fun fixHour(h: Double): Double { val x = h % 24; return if (x < 0) x + 24 else x }
    private fun fixAngle(a: Double): Double { val x = a % 360; return if (x < 0) x + 360 else x }

    private fun julian(y: Int, m: Int, d: Int): Double {
        var yy = y; var mm = m
        if (mm <= 2) { yy -= 1; mm += 12 }
        val a = floor(yy / 100.0)
        val b = 2 - a + floor(a / 4)
        return floor(365.25 * (yy + 4716)) + floor(30.6001 * (mm + 1)) + d + b - 1524.5
    }

    private class Sun(val decl: Double, val eqt: Double)

    private fun sun(jd: Double): Sun {
        val d = jd - 2451545.0
        val g = fixAngle(357.529 + 0.98560028 * d)
        val q = fixAngle(280.459 + 0.98564736 * d)
        val l = fixAngle(q + 1.915 * sin(rad(g)) + 0.020 * sin(rad(2 * g)))
        val e = 23.439 - 0.00000036 * d
        val ra = fixHour(deg(atan2(cos(rad(e)) * sin(rad(l)), cos(rad(l)))) / 15)
        return Sun(deg(asin(sin(rad(e)) * sin(rad(l)))), q / 15 - ra)
    }

    private fun midDay(jd: Double, t: Double) = fixHour(12 - sun(jd + t).eqt)

    private fun angleTime(jd: Double, lat: Double, angle: Double, t: Double, ccw: Boolean): Double {
        val decl = sun(jd + t).decl
        val noon = midDay(jd, t)
        val x = (-sin(rad(angle)) - sin(rad(decl)) * sin(rad(lat))) / (cos(rad(decl)) * cos(rad(lat)))
        val v = deg(acos(x)) / 15
        return noon + if (ccw) -v else v
    }

    private fun asrTime(jd: Double, lat: Double, factor: Double, t: Double): Double {
        val decl = sun(jd + t).decl
        val angle = -deg(atan(1.0 / (factor + tan(rad(abs(lat - decl))))))
        return angleTime(jd, lat, angle, t, false)
    }

    /** Returns local-clock hours (can be NaN at extreme latitudes). */
    fun compute(
        y: Int, m: Int, d: Int, lat: Double, lng: Double, tz: Double, method: Method, hanafi: Boolean
    ): Map<Prayer, Double> {
        val jd = julian(y, m, d) - lng / (15.0 * 24)
        val fajr = angleTime(jd, lat, method.fajr, 5.0 / 24, true)
        val sunrise = angleTime(jd, lat, 0.833, 6.0 / 24, true)
        val dhuhr = midDay(jd, 12.0 / 24)
        val asr = asrTime(jd, lat, if (hanafi) 2.0 else 1.0, 13.0 / 24)
        val sunset = angleTime(jd, lat, 0.833, 18.0 / 24, false)
        val isha = if (method.ishaMin > 0) sunset + method.ishaMin / 60 else angleTime(jd, lat, method.isha, 18.0 / 24, false)
        val adj = tz - lng / 15
        return mapOf(
            Prayer.FAJR to fajr + adj, Prayer.SUNRISE to sunrise + adj, Prayer.DHUHR to dhuhr + adj,
            Prayer.ASR to asr + adj, Prayer.MAGHRIB to sunset + adj, Prayer.ISHA to isha + adj
        )
    }

    /** Initial great-circle bearing from (lat,lng) to the Kaaba, degrees from true north. */
    fun qiblaBearing(lat: Double, lng: Double): Double {
        val p1 = rad(lat); val p2 = rad(21.4225); val dl = rad(39.8262 - lng)
        val y = sin(dl)
        val x = cos(p1) * tan(p2) - sin(p1) * cos(dl)
        return (deg(atan2(y, x)) + 360) % 360
    }
}
@@@FILE app/src/main/java/com/bjdfarhma/salah/Prefs.kt
package com.bjdfarhma.salah

import android.content.Context
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.*
import androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

private val Context.store by preferencesDataStore("salah_settings")

data class AppSettings(
    val lang: String = "bn",
    val dark: Boolean = true,
    val onboarded: Boolean = false,
    val lat: Double = 23.8103,
    val lng: Double = 90.4125,
    val place: String = "Dhaka",
    val method: String = "KARACHI",
    val hanafi: Boolean = true,
    val count: Int = 0,
    val target: Int = 33,
    val dhikr: Int = 0
)

object K {
    val lang = stringPreferencesKey("lang")
    val dark = booleanPreferencesKey("dark")
    val onboarded = booleanPreferencesKey("onboarded")
    val lat = doublePreferencesKey("lat")
    val lng = doublePreferencesKey("lng")
    val place = stringPreferencesKey("place")
    val method = stringPreferencesKey("method")
    val hanafi = booleanPreferencesKey("hanafi")
    val count = intPreferencesKey("count")
    val target = intPreferencesKey("target")
    val dhikr = intPreferencesKey("dhikr")
}

class Prefs(private val ctx: Context) {
    private val d = AppSettings()
    val flow: Flow<AppSettings> = ctx.store.data.map { p ->
        AppSettings(
            lang = p[K.lang] ?: d.lang, dark = p[K.dark] ?: d.dark, onboarded = p[K.onboarded] ?: d.onboarded,
            lat = p[K.lat] ?: d.lat, lng = p[K.lng] ?: d.lng, place = p[K.place] ?: d.place,
            method = p[K.method] ?: d.method, hanafi = p[K.hanafi] ?: d.hanafi,
            count = p[K.count] ?: d.count, target = p[K.target] ?: d.target, dhikr = p[K.dhikr] ?: d.dhikr
        )
    }

    suspend fun update(block: (MutablePreferences) -> Unit) {
        ctx.store.edit { block(it) }
    }
}

fun tr(l: String, bn: String, en: String) = if (l == "bn") bn else en
fun num(loc: Locale, x: Int): String = String.format(loc, "%d", x)

fun schedule(date: LocalDate, s: AppSettings, zone: ZoneId): Map<Prayer, ZonedDateTime> {
    val method = PrayerCalc.methods.firstOrNull { it.id == s.method } ?: PrayerCalc.methods[0]
    val start = date.atStartOfDay(zone)
    val tz = zone.rules.getOffset(start.toInstant()).totalSeconds / 3600.0
    val raw = PrayerCalc.compute(date.year, date.monthValue, date.dayOfMonth, s.lat, s.lng, tz, method, s.hanafi)
    return raw.filterValues { !it.isNaN() }.mapValues { start.plusSeconds(Math.round(it.value * 60) * 60) }
}

fun nextPrayer(now: ZonedDateTime, s: AppSettings): Pair<Prayer, ZonedDateTime>? {
    val five = listOf(Prayer.FAJR, Prayer.DHUHR, Prayer.ASR, Prayer.MAGHRIB, Prayer.ISHA)
    for (offset in 0..1) {
        val day = schedule(now.toLocalDate().plusDays(offset.toLong()), s, now.zone)
        for (p in five) {
            val t = day[p] ?: continue
            if (t.isAfter(now)) return p to t
        }
    }
    return null
}

@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
fun lastLocation(ctx: Context): Location? {
    val lm = ctx.getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE) as LocationManager
    return lm.getProviders(true).mapNotNull { runCatching { lm.getLastKnownLocation(it) }.getOrNull() }.maxByOrNull { it.time }
}

@Composable
fun GpsButton(s: AppSettings, prefs: Prefs, scope: CoroutineScope, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val ctx = LocalContext.current
    val l = s.lang
    var explain by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var msg by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var denied by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    fun apply() {
        val loc = lastLocation(ctx)
        if (loc == null) {
            msg = tr(l, "অবস্থান পাওয়া যায়নি। ফোনের লোকেশন চালু করে আবার চেষ্টা করুন।", "Couldn't get a fix. Turn on device location and try again.")
        } else {
            msg = null
            scope.launch {
                prefs.update {
                    it[K.lat] = loc.latitude; it[K.lng] = loc.longitude
                    it[K.place] = tr(l, "জিপিএস অবস্থান", "GPS location")
                }
            }
        }
    }

    val launcher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()) { r ->
        if (r.values.any { it }) { denied = false; apply() } else {
            denied = true
            msg = tr(l, "অনুমতি দেওয়া হয়নি। আপনি শহর বেছে নিয়ে নামাজের সময় দেখতে পারবেন।", "Permission denied. You can still pick a city manually.")
        }
    }
    fun granted() = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(ctx, android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED ||
        ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(ctx, android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED

    Column(modifier) {
        Button(onClick = { if (granted()) apply() else explain = true }) {
            Text(tr(l, "জিপিএস দিয়ে অবস্থান নিন", "Use my location"))
        }
        msg?.let { Text(it, Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant, fontSize = 13.sp) }
        if (denied) TextButton(onClick = {
            ctx.startActivity(Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS, Uri.fromParts("package", ctx.packageName, null)))
        }) { Text(tr(l, "সেটিংস খুলুন", "Open app settings")) }
    }
    if (explain) AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = { explain = false },
        title = { Text(tr(l, "অবস্থানের অনুমতি", "Location permission")) },
        text = { Text(tr(l, "সঠিক নামাজের সময় ও কিবলার দিক হিসাব করতে আপনার আনুমানিক অবস্থান লাগে। এটি শুধু আপনার ফোনেই ব্যবহার হয়।", "Your approximate location is used only on this device to calculate accurate prayer times and Qibla direction.")) },
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = {
            explain = false
            launcher.launch(arrayOf(android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION))
        }) { Text(tr(l, "চালিয়ে যান", "Continue")) } },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { explain = false }) { Text(tr(l, "এখন না", "Not now")) } }
    )
}

@Composable
fun HomeScreen(s: AppSettings, prefs: Prefs, scope: CoroutineScope) {
    val l = s.lang
    val loc = Locale(l)
    val zone = ZoneId.systemDefault()
    var now by remember { mutableStateOf(ZonedDateTime.now(zone)) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { while (true) { now = ZonedDateTime.now(zone); delay(1000) } }

    val today = remember(s.lat, s.lng, s.method, s.hanafi, now.toLocalDate()) { schedule(now.toLocalDate(), s, zone) }
    val next = remember(s.lat, s.lng, s.method, s.hanafi, now.toEpochSecond() / 60) { nextPrayer(now, s) }
    val timeFmt = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("hh:mm a", loc)
    val h = HijrahDate.from(now.toLocalDate())
    val hijri = "${num(loc, h.get(ChronoField.DAY_OF_MONTH))} ${(if (l == "bn") hijriBn else hijriEn)[h.get(ChronoField.MONTH_OF_YEAR) - 1]} ${num(loc, h.get(ChronoField.YEAR))}"
    val greg = now.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("EEEE, d MMMM yyyy", loc))

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).statusBarsPadding().padding(16.dp)) {
        Text(tr(l, "আসসালামু আলাইকুম", "Assalamu Alaikum"), fontSize = 14.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary)
        Text(greg, fontSize = 20.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
        Text("$hijri " + tr(l, "হি. (গণনাকৃত)", "AH (calculated)"), fontSize = 14.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))

        Card(colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = Emerald), shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(20.dp)) {
                Text(tr(l, "পরবর্তী নামাজ", "Next prayer"), color = Gold, fontSize = 14.sp)
                if (next != null) {
                    val d = Duration.between(now, next.second).coerceAtLeast(Duration.ZERO)
                    Text(tr(l, next.first.bn, next.first.en), color = Ivory, fontSize = 32.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Text(next.second.format(timeFmt), color = Ivory, fontSize = 18.sp)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        String.format(loc, "%02d:%02d:%02d", d.seconds / 3600, (d.seconds % 3600) / 60, d.seconds % 60),
                        color = Gold, fontSize = 36.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                    )
                } else Text(tr(l, "এই অবস্থানের জন্য সময় হিসাব করা যায়নি", "Times unavailable for this location"), color = Ivory)
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))

        Card(shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(vertical = 8.dp)) {
                Prayer.values().forEach { p ->
                    val t = today[p]
                    val isNext = next?.first == p
                    Row(
                        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                            .background(if (isNext) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer else Color.Transparent)
                            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 14.dp),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                    ) {
                        Text(tr(l, p.bn, p.en), fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = if (isNext) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal)
                        Text(t?.format(timeFmt) ?: "--", fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = if (isNext) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))

        Card(shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
                Text(tr(l, "অবস্থান", "Location"), fontSize = 13.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                Text(s.place, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                GpsButton(s, prefs, scope)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                Text(
                    tr(l, "সময়গুলো জ্যোতির্বিজ্ঞানের হিসাবে বের করা, ইন্টারনেট ছাড়াই কাজ করে। স্থানীয় মসজিদের সময়সূচি থেকে কয়েক মিনিট আলাদা হতে পারে।",
                        "Times are calculated astronomically and work offline. They may differ by a few minutes from your local mosque's timetable."),
                    fontSize = 12.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                )
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(24.dp))
    }
}

@Composable
fun QiblaScreen(s: AppSettings) {
    val l = s.lang
    val ctx = LocalContext.current
    val bearing = PrayerCalc.qiblaBearing(s.lat, s.lng).toFloat()
    val sm = remember { ctx.getSystemService(Context.SENSOR_SERVICE) as SensorManager }
    val sensor = remember { sm.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR) }
    var heading by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

    DisposableEffect(sensor) {
        if (sensor == null) onDispose { } else {
            val listener = object : SensorEventListener {
                override fun onSensorChanged(e: SensorEvent) {
                    val r = FloatArray(9); SensorManager.getRotationMatrixFromVector(r, e.values)
                    val o = FloatArray(3); SensorManager.getOrientation(r, o)
                    heading = ((Math.toDegrees(o[0].toDouble()) + 360) % 360).toFloat()
                }
                override fun onAccuracyChanged(s: Sensor?, a: Int) {}
            }
            sm.registerListener(listener, sensor, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_UI)
            onDispose { sm.unregisterListener(listener) }
        }
    }

    val diff = ((bearing - heading + 540) % 360) - 180
    val aligned = sensor != null && abs(diff) < 5
    val ink = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
    val line = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline

    Column(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).statusBarsPadding().padding(16.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
    ) {
        Text(tr(l, "কিবলা", "Qibla"), fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        Text(
            tr(l, "কাবার দিক: উত্তর থেকে ${num(Locale(l), bearing.toInt())}°", "Kaaba direction: ${bearing.toInt()}° from north") + " · " + s.place,
            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(24.dp))
        if (sensor != null) {
            Canvas(Modifier.size(300.dp)) {
                val c = center; val r = size.minDimension / 2 - 8f
                drawCircle(if (aligned) Gold else line, radius = r, style = Stroke(if (aligned) 8f else 4f))
                rotate(-heading, c) {
                    for (i in 0 until 36) {
                        val len = if (i % 9 == 0) 30f else 12f
                        rotate(i * 10f, c) { drawLine(ink, Offset(c.x, c.y - r), Offset(c.x, c.y - r + len), strokeWidth = 3f) }
                    }
                    drawCircle(Color(0xFFD9382B), radius = 9f, center = Offset(c.x, c.y - r + 46f))
                }
                rotate(bearing - heading, c) {
                    drawLine(Gold, c, Offset(c.x, c.y - r + 40f), strokeWidth = 10f, cap = StrokeCap.Round)
                    drawCircle(Gold, radius = 18f, center = Offset(c.x, c.y - r + 40f))
                }
                drawCircle(Emerald, radius = 14f, center = c)
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
            Text(
                if (aligned) tr(l, "কিবলার দিকে ঠিক আছে", "You are facing the Qibla") else tr(l, "ফোন ঘুরিয়ে সোনালি তীরটি উপরে আনুন", "Turn until the gold arrow points up"),
                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = if (aligned) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary else ink, textAlign = TextAlign.Center
            )
            Text(tr(l, "ফোনের দিক: ${num(Locale(l), heading.toInt())}°", "Heading: ${heading.toInt()}°"), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
        } else {
            Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Text(
                    tr(l, "এই ফোনে কম্পাস সেন্সর নেই। অন্য কম্পাস দিয়ে উত্তর খুঁজে সেখান থেকে ${num(Locale(l), bearing.toInt())}° ঘড়ির কাঁটার দিকে ঘুরুন।",
                        "No compass sensor on this device. Find north with another compass, then turn ${bearing.toInt()}° clockwise."),
                    Modifier.padding(16.dp)
                )
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        Text(
            tr(l, "ক্যালিব্রেশন: ফোনটি বাতাসে ৮ (আট) আকারে কয়েকবার ঘোরান। ধাতব বস্তু ও চুম্বক থেকে দূরে রাখুন। কম্পাস চৌম্বক উত্তর ব্যবহার করে, তাই সামান্য ভুল হতে পারে।",
                "Calibrate by moving the phone in a figure-8. Keep away from metal and magnets. The compass uses magnetic north, so small errors are possible."),
            fontSize = 12.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
        )
    }
}

data class Dhikr(val ar: String, val trBn: String, val trEn: String, val mBn: String, val mEn: String)

private val dhikrs = listOf(
    Dhikr("سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ", "সুবহানাল্লাহ", "SubhanAllah", "আল্লাহ পবিত্র", "Glory be to Allah"),
    Dhikr("الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ", "আলহামদুলিল্লাহ", "Alhamdulillah", "সমস্ত প্রশংসা আল্লাহর", "All praise is for Allah"),
    Dhikr("اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ", "আল্লাহু আকবার", "Allahu Akbar", "আল্লাহ সবচেয়ে মহান", "Allah is the Greatest"),
    Dhikr("أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ", "আস্তাগফিরুল্লাহ", "Astaghfirullah", "আমি আল্লাহর কাছে ক্ষমা চাই", "I seek forgiveness from Allah"),
    Dhikr("اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ", "আল্লাহুম্মা সাল্লি আলা মুহাম্মাদ", "Allahumma salli ala Muhammad", "হে আল্লাহ, মুহাম্মাদ ﷺ-এর উপর রহমত বর্ষণ করুন", "O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad ﷺ")
)

@Composable
fun TasbihScreen(s: AppSettings, prefs: Prefs, scope: CoroutineScope) {
    val l = s.lang
    val loc = Locale(l)
    val haptic = LocalHapticFeedback.current
    val d = dhikrs[s.dhikr.coerceIn(0, dhikrs.lastIndex)]

    Column(
        Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).statusBarsPadding().padding(16.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
    ) {
        Text(tr(l, "তাসবিহ", "Tasbih"), fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        Row(Modifier.horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            dhikrs.forEachIndexed { i, x ->
                FilterChip(selected = s.dhikr == i, onClick = {
                    scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.dhikr] = i; it[K.count] = 0 } }
                }, label = { Text(tr(l, x.trBn, x.trEn)) })
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
        Text(d.ar, fontSize = 34.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary, textAlign = TextAlign.Center)
        Text(tr(l, d.mBn, d.mEn), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant, textAlign = TextAlign.Center)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(24.dp))
        Box(
            Modifier.size(220.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(Emerald)
                .clickable {
                    val n = s.count + 1
                    if (n == s.target) haptic.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.LongPress)
                    scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.count] = n } }
                },
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                Text(num(loc, s.count), fontSize = 64.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = Ivory)
                Text("/ ${num(loc, s.target)}", fontSize = 18.sp, color = Gold)
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
        Text(tr(l, "গোলটিতে ট্যাপ করুন", "Tap the circle"), fontSize = 12.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
        if (s.count >= s.target) Text(tr(l, "লক্ষ্য পূর্ণ হয়েছে", "Target reached"), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            listOf(33, 99, 100).forEach { t ->
                FilterChip(selected = s.target == t, onClick = { scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.target] = t } } }, label = { Text(num(loc, t)) })
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        OutlinedButton(onClick = { scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.count] = 0 } } }) { Text(tr(l, "রিসেট", "Reset")) }
    }
}

@Composable
fun SettingsScreen(s: AppSettings, prefs: Prefs, scope: CoroutineScope) {
    val l = s.lang
    var cityDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var methodDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    @Composable
    fun Row2(title: String, sub: String? = null, trailing: @Composable () -> Unit) {
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 10.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(title, fontSize = 16.sp)
                if (sub != null) Text(sub, fontSize = 12.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            }
            trailing()
        }
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).statusBarsPadding().padding(16.dp)) {
        Text(tr(l, "সেটিংস", "Settings"), fontSize = 24.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp)) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 6.dp)) {
                Row2(tr(l, "ভাষা", "Language")) {
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        FilterChip(selected = l == "bn", onClick = { scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.lang] = "bn" } } }, label = { Text("বাংলা") })
                        FilterChip(selected = l == "en", onClick = { scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.lang] = "en" } } }, label = { Text("English") })
                    }
                }
                HorizontalDivider()
                Row2(tr(l, "ডার্ক থিম", "Dark theme")) {
                    Switch(checked = s.dark, onCheckedChange = { v -> scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.dark] = v } } })
                }
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp)) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 6.dp)) {
                Row2(tr(l, "শহর", "City"), s.place) { TextButton(onClick = { cityDialog = true }) { Text(tr(l, "বদলান", "Change")) } }
                HorizontalDivider()
                val m = PrayerCalc.methods.firstOrNull { it.id == s.method } ?: PrayerCalc.methods[0]
                Row2(tr(l, "হিসাব পদ্ধতি", "Calculation method"), m.label) { TextButton(onClick = { methodDialog = true }) { Text(tr(l, "বদলান", "Change")) } }
                HorizontalDivider()
                Row2(tr(l, "আসর: হানাফি", "Asr: Hanafi"), tr(l, "বন্ধ করলে শাফেয়ি/জমহুর", "Off = Shafi'i / standard")) {
                    Switch(checked = s.hanafi, onCheckedChange = { v -> scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.hanafi] = v } } })
                }
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
        Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp)) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
                Text("Salah Time v0.1.0", fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                Text(
                    tr(l, "নামাজের সময়, কিবলা ও তাসবিহ — সবই ইন্টারনেট ছাড়া কাজ করে।", "Prayer times, Qibla and Tasbih — all work offline."),
                    fontSize = 13.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                )
            }
        }
    }

    if (cityDialog) AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = { cityDialog = false },
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = { cityDialog = false }) { Text(tr(l, "বন্ধ", "Close")) } },
        title = { Text(tr(l, "শহর বাছাই করুন", "Choose a city")) },
        text = {
            Column(Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
                cities.forEach { c ->
                    Text(tr(l, c.bn, c.name), Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable {
                        scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.lat] = c.lat; it[K.lng] = c.lng; it[K.place] = tr(l, c.bn, c.name) } }
                        cityDialog = false
                    }.padding(vertical = 12.dp), fontSize = 16.sp)
                }
            }
        }
    )
    if (methodDialog) AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = { methodDialog = false },
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = { methodDialog = false }) { Text(tr(l, "বন্ধ", "Close")) } },
        title = { Text(tr(l, "হিসাব পদ্ধতি", "Calculation method")) },
        text = {
            Column {
                PrayerCalc.methods.forEach { m ->
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable {
                        scope.launch { prefs.update { it[K.method] = m.id } }
                        methodDialog = false
                    }.padding(vertical = 10.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        RadioButton(selected = s.method == m.id, onClick = null)
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Text(m.label)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    )
}
@@@FILE app/src/main/java/com/bjdfarhma/salah/Theme.kt
package com.bjdfarhma.salah

import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color

val Emerald = Color(0xFF0B6B4F)
val Gold = Color(0xFFD4AF37)
val Ivory = Color(0xFFF7F5EF)
val Obsidian = Color(0xFF0A1210)
val ObsidianSurface = Color(0xFF14221D)

@Composable
fun SalahTheme(dark: Boolean, content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val cs = if (dark) darkColorScheme(
        primary = Gold, onPrimary = Obsidian, primaryContainer = Color(0xFF3A3115), onPrimaryContainer = Gold,
        secondary = Emerald, onSecondary = Ivory, secondaryContainer = Color(0xFF1F4A3B), onSecondaryContainer = Ivory,
        background = Obsidian, onBackground = Ivory, surface = ObsidianSurface, onSurface = Ivory,
        surfaceVariant = Color(0xFF1C2E27), onSurfaceVariant = Color(0xFFC9D3CE), outline = Color(0xFF3A4F46)
    ) else lightColorScheme(
        primary = Emerald, onPrimary = Color.White, primaryContainer = Color(0xFFCDE8DC), onPrimaryContainer = Color(0xFF05382A),
        secondary = Gold, onSecondary = Obsidian, secondaryContainer = Color(0xFFCDE8DC), onSecondaryContainer = Color(0xFF05382A),
